answer.reason: The verses tell of Hilkiah finding the book of the law and of his part in Josiah's reforms, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: found the book of the law in the house of the LORD and gave it to Shaphan
clauses.quote: I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD.

clauses.english: went at the king's command to ask the LORD about the book from Huldah the prophetess
was commanded by Josiah to bring the vessels made for Baal out of the temple
clauses.quote: the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest

doubts: 2CH 35:8 names a Hilkiah, a ruler of the house of God, who may be this high priest or a namesake; left out.
The genealogies (1CH 6:13, 1CH 9:11, EZR 7:1, NEH 11:11) only list his descendants, so they are not used.
